sample_unit: questions (each answered by four AI models)

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient education responses versus recommended patient literacy thresholds
links.effect: AI responses were generally accurate and comprehensive but difficult to read, requiring college-level literacy; ChatGPT-5 had the most difficult-to-read responses (P < .001).
links.quote: AI-generated information on functional appliances was generally accurate and comprehensive but often exceeded recommended patient literacy thresholds.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education responses in plain language
links.effect: Responses required college-level literacy; treatment-related questions had lower readability scores than lifestyle queries across all models (P < .001).
links.quote: AI-generated responses were generally accurate and comprehensive but difficult to read, requiring college-level literacy.

screen.reason: Evaluates performance (accuracy, readability, and comprehensiveness) of four LLMs answering patient FAQs on functional appliances without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
